findings.location: docs/status/FORWARD-PLAN.md Phase 4 and Resolved decision 4 (also investigation sections E and H)
findings.problem: The plan states 'a Help group exists -- rows 7.1 / 7.1a / 7.1b' in core-acceptance-test-plan.md. Verified against the file: those rows exist but inside Group 7 'Function keys' (F1 opens Help); there is no standalone Help group (groups are 1 Shell, 2 Menu/Settings, 3 File navigator, 4 Editor, 5 Command-line, 6 Macros, 7 Function keys, 8 Theme, 9 Config recovery). The misstatement leaves the Phase-4 executor an unresolved choice about where the new rich-renderer Help rows go.
findings.fix: Correct both Phase 4 and decision 4: say the Help acceptance rows (7.1/7.1a/7.1b/7.1c/7.1d) currently live inside Group 7 'Function keys', there is no standalone Help group today, and state explicitly whether the new rich-renderer rows extend Group 7 in place or a new Help group is split out.
